subject: Onboarding runway — request for bridge credits and trial extension
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina@payflux.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding runway — PayFlux request

Hi Hannah / Redwood team,

Quick context: our engineering team hit an unexpected blocker with the payment connector (third-party SDK regression) that pushed our integration sprint out by ~4 weeks. We were hoping to finish the POC and a small pilot during the current trial window, but with the delay we won't have enough run rate to finish evaluation.

Ask: would Redwood consider a one-time bridge — 60 extra trial days + an incremental $3,000 in free credits — so we can complete the integration and run the pilot? If possible, we'd also like a short session with someone from Redwood Optimize to ensure we're not burning tokens during debugging.

What we can commit to: a mutual action plan (attached) with milestones and a firm pilot completion date by Feb 15, 2027. We're aiming to convert to a committed Dedicated instance if the pilot goes well.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (payflux-mup-v1.xlsx) and a short integration summary, and can jump on a quick call if helpful. Thanks for considering — we're excited about Redwood but need a little runway.

Best,
Lina Gomez
Head of Integrations, PayFlux
Lina@payflux.io

Attachments: payflux-mup-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), integration-summary.txt (log excerpt)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@payflux.io>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding runway — PayFlux request

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear note and the MUP. I'm sorry to hear about the SDK regression; that's always painful during a POC.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in Rishi for approval on credits/extension.
- Dev, can you confirm expected additional time and whether a temporary sandbox bump (short-lived) is enough?
- Lina, could you confirm the prioritized milestones in the attached spreadsheet and the single point of contact on your engineering side for the next 6 weeks?

We're optimistic here — we do occasional trial extensions for integration hiccups, but we usually tie them to a mutual action plan and a follow-up call. If you're available this week I can do 30 minutes Thurs 10–11am PT.

Hannah
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

--
On Mon, 30 Nov 2026 at 09:12, Lina Gomez <lina@payflux.io> wrote:
> Quick context: our engineering team hit an unexpected blocker...

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina@payflux.io>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding runway — technical assessment

Hi team,

I looked through the integration notes Lina shared. Short summary:
- The third-party SDK regression affects chunked webhooks; PayFlux's engineers will need a small SDK patch and a re-run of connector tests. Estimated delay: 3–4 weeks.
- The pilot itself doesn't need sustained high QPS; most of the token spend right now is from integration retries and verbose debug calls.

Suggested mitigation:
1) Issue a temporary credits bump (one-time) to avoid them hitting token limits while debugging.
2) Enable stricter rate limits / sampling on the test routes to keep costs predictable.
3) Offer a 60-day extension on trial window to align with their corrected timeline.

Attachments: integration-plan.pdf (1-page plan), error-sample.txt (excerpt of failing calls).

I'm happy to join a call with PayFlux engineering to walk through the patch steps — I'll block time if we decide to offer.

— Dev
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lina Gomez <lina@payflux.io>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding runway — approval (conditional)

Hannah / team / Lina,

Thanks for the clear notes. Approve the following one-time concession for PayFlux PF-2026-0183:
- 60-day trial extension from the current expiry date.
- $3,000 in free credits applied to their trial account (non-transferable, single-use).

Conditions:
1) The attached mutual action plan (payflux-mup-v1.xlsx) must be signed by PayFlux and returned within 7 business days.
2) PayFlux agrees to a 30-minute onboarding review with Redwood Optimize within the first 10 days of the extension so we can minimize unnecessary token spend.
3) If the pilot stalls again >30 days, we reserve the right to revisit concessions.

Hannah — please coordinate the DocuSign (I added a template we can use) and let me know when to apply the credits. Lina — signing and the onboarding review are the only asks from your side.

Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: docusign-extension-link.txt (signed template + link)

From: Lina Gomez <lina@payflux.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 16:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding runway — request for bridge credits and trial extension

Fantastic — thank you, Rishi and team. We appreciate the fast decision and the clarity on conditions. I've attached the signed MUP (payflux-mup-v1.xlsx) and scheduled the Optimize session for Mon Dec 8 at 10am PT.

I also pasted the DocuSign link in the attached docusign-extension-link.txt — we'll complete that today. Once the credits are live we'll resume work on the SDK patch and keep you posted on milestones.

Really appreciate the partnership — excited to get the pilot back on track.

Best,
Lina
Head of Integrations, PayFlux, Inc.

Attachments: payflux-mup-v1.xlsx (signed), docusign-extension-link.txt
